name: A Portable Power Source
summary: Mux Manascrambler needs steady power for his ectoplasm. Rumour points to Magma Lord Bokk in the Burning Steppes, whose heart is a Magma Core, and Mux asks you to bring it to Gadgetzan.

sections.title: A Heart of Endless Heat
sections.body: Mux Manascrambler needs power he can carry to keep the ectoplasm active. Rumour says Magma Lord Bokk, a mighty elemental, has a Magma Core for a heart. Its heat never ends. Bokk is said to dwell in the Burning Steppes, south of Blackrock Mountain and west of the Pillar of Ash. Mux wants you to bring the core to Gadgetzan to run his extra-dimensional ghost revealer.

sections.title: Power at Last
sections.body: Mux Manascrambler is thrilled when you arrive with the core. He declares that it will give the ghost revealer all the energy it needs.

faq.q: Why does Mux Manascrambler need a power source?
aliases: what is the power source for
faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler needs steady, portable energy to keep the ectoplasm active and run his extra-dimensional ghost revealer.
Rumour says Magma Lord Bokk is a mighty elemental with a Magma Core for a heart. Its heat never runs dry.

faq.q: Where in the Burning Steppes can Magma Lord Bokk be found?
faq.answer: Rumour places Magma Lord Bokk in the Burning Steppes, south of Blackrock Mountain and west of the Pillar of Ash.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into Mux's work?
faq.answer: This follows Hunting for Ectoplasm, and A Shifty Merchant follows it.
